description: Webapp domain hooks — the pipeline's invariants enforced deterministically, independent of any model's prompt discipline: the COMMIT LABEL (PostToolUse — once that gated commit lands, stamp committed + fixed-pending-deploy and drop needs-deploy on #N so close-deployed-issues.yml can never orphan a merged fix), and the PUSH GATE (sub-agents can never push; the main session's push always asks the human — push is the pipeline's one hard human checkpoint before CI deploys).
